treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Italian Republic and the Government of the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital and the prevention of fiscal evasion (1995)
eif_quote: Israele ... Firma: Roma 08.09.1995; Ratifica: L. 09.10.1997, n.371 In vigore dal : 06.08.1998
source_title: Legge 9 ottobre 1997 n. 371, Suppl. ord. G.U. Serie generale n. 254 del 30-10-1997 (Italian and English texts, scanned)

rates.quote: a.10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25% of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b. il 15% dell'ammontare lordo dei dividendi in tutti gli altri casi.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the law of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

Tuttavia, tali canoni sono imponibili anche nello Stato contraente dal quale essi provengono ed in conformità alla legislazione di detto Stato, ma, se la persona che percepisce i canoni ne è l'effettivo beneficiario, l'imposta così applicata, non può eccedere il 10 per cento dell'ammontare lordo dei canoni.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 30 (Limitation of benefits — abuse, applied by mutual agreement of competent authorities; not an MLI-style PPT)
ppt.quote: Le autorità competenti degli Stati contraenti possono, di comune accordo, non concedere i benefici previsti dalla presente Convenzione ad una data persona, o relativamente ad una data transazione, qualora nella loro opinione il godimento di tali benefici, sotto determinate circostanze, costituisca un abuso della Convenzione stessa.

notes: Art. 30 is an anti-abuse clause requiring mutual agreement of the competent authorities (not a unilateral principal-purpose test); Italy is not an MLI Party. Royalties: copyright of literary, artistic or scientific works (excluding cinematograph films and radio/TV recordings) exempt in the source State (Art. 12(3)); 10% applies to other royalties incl. software. Art. 10(3): Israeli residents receiving dividends from Italian companies entitled to refund of the 'maggiorazione di conguaglio' (Italian equalisation tax, since abolished) subject to 12-month holding for 10(2)(a) cases — not modelled. Art. 10(2)(a) itself has no minimum holding period. No interest exemption for governments found in Art. 11. Art. 31(2): provisions apply to income for tax periods beginning on or after 1 January of the calendar year following the exchange of instruments (EIF 1998-08-06 -> 1999-01-01). Texts in English, Italian and Hebrew equally authentic; English prevails in case of doubt (dividend and interest quotes taken from the English text, royalty quote from the Italian). MLI not applicable.
